title: AppGate User Investigation
description: Select a user to see their identity summary. Starting point for the per-user investigation view; panels will be added incrementally.

options.query: `appgate_lf` | search ag_user="$user$" | stats values(ag_user) as "User", values(ag_ou) as "Org Unit", values(first_name) as "First Name", values(last_name) as "Last Name", values(idp) as "Identity Provider", values(auth_type) as "Auth Type", values(clearance) as "Clearance", values(risk_score) as "Risk Score", values(user_role) as "Role", values(home_base) as "Home Base", values(device_trust) as "Device Trust", values(geo_location) as "Geo Location", values(mfa_provided) as "MFA Provided", values(ia_training) as "IA Training Current", values(device_hostname) as "Device Hostname", values(device_os) as "Operating System", values(device_client_type) as "Client Type", values(client_version) as "Client Version", values(ag_country) as "Country", values(ag_city) as "City", dc(ag_client_ip) as "Distinct Client IPs", dc(appliance) as "Appliances Used", dc(entitlement) as "Entitlements Used", dc(session) as "Sessions", count as "Total Events", earliest(_time) as f, latest(_time) as l | eval "First Seen"=strftime(f, "%F %T"), "Last Seen"=strftime(l, "%F %T") | fields - f, l | transpose 1 | rename column as Field, "row 1" as Value | search Value=*

options.markdown:
# AppGate SDP — User Investigation
Select a **User** above. Rows with no value are omitted — a missing Clearance or Risk Score means that user's events carry no `scripted_user_claims` block, which is normal for service accounts.

viz_identity_summary.title: Identity Summary
viz_identity_summary.description: Identity, UCS risk profile, device, and activity footprint for the selected user.
